Gruppen har :customers kunder och är val: The group has :customers customers and is chosen in :campaigns campaigns. Move the customers and change the campaigns first.

The code can be at most 20 characters.

Skriv valutan som tre bokstäver, till ex: Write the currency as three letters, for example SEK or EUR.

Bara en vanlig prislista kan vara standa: Only an ordinary price list can be the default for its currency.
En kampanj behöver både ett startdatum o: A campaign needs both a start date and an end date.
Välj om kanalprislistan gäller kassan el: Choose whether the channel price list is for the till or the customer portal.
Skriv procenten som ett tal mellan −99 o: Write the percentage as a number between −99 and 1,000, for example −12 for 12 % lower.
The price list does not exist.
A list cannot follow a campaign.
Listan måste ha samma valuta som den lis: The list must have the same currency as the list it follows.
Listorna skulle följa varandra i en ring: The lists would follow each other in a circle. Choose another list.
A chosen customer group does not exist.
Valutan och momsgrunden kan inte ändras: The currency and VAT basis cannot be changed once the list has prices or is followed by another list. Make a new list.
Listan används av kunder eller kundgrupp: The list is used by customers or customer groups and must stay an ordinary price list.
The customer group does not exist.
Listan är arkiverad. Återställ den för a: The list is archived. Restore it to change prices.
The price is archived and cannot be changed.
Skriv antalet som ett tal, till exempel: Write the quantity as a number, for example 10 or 2.5.
Det nya priset måste börja efter att det: The new price must start after the old one started.
Enheten :unit går inte att räkna om till: The unit :unit cannot be converted to the article's unit :stock. Add a conversion on the article first.
Skriv rabatten som procent mellan 0 och: Write the discount as a percentage between 0 and 100, for example 12.5.
Artikeln har redan ett pris i listan för: The article already has a price in the list for the same quantity and unit that applies :period. End it first, or choose a period that does not overlap.
Skriv ett datum och ett antal, till exem: Write a date and a quantity, for example 10.
Det finns inget pris för artikeln den da: The article has no price on that day.
Priset är borttaget. Det hade inte börja: The price is removed. It had not started to apply.
Priset gäller till och med i går och fin: The price applies up to and including yesterday and stays in the history.
Priset är arkiverat och finns kvar i his: The price is archived and stays in the history.
Prislistan :name är tillagd. Lägg in pri: The price list :name is added. Enter the prices on the list's page.
exklusive moms per :unit. Det gäller när: excluding VAT per :unit. It applies when no price list or campaign gives another price.
Ingen ändring av grundpriset är sparad ä: No change of the base price is saved yet. The history starts at the next change.
Artikeln finns inte i någon prislista el: The article is in no price list or campaign. Everyone gets the base price.
Priser för artikeln i prislistor: The article's prices in price lists
Listor som räknar ut priset med en regel: Lists that work out the price by a rule
Priset en kund utan egen lista får, i kr: The price a customer without an own list gets, in kronor. You see a customer's own prices on the customer's tab Prices.
Priserna nedan går före regeln för just: The prices below take precedence over the rule for those articles.
Listan är arkiverad. Återställ den under: The list is archived. Restore it under Price lists to change prices.
Sök på artikelnummer eller benämning: Search by article number or name
Tomt är artikelns egen försäljningsenhet: Empty is the article's own sales unit.
Tomt gäller från första enheten. Flera r: Empty applies from the first unit. Several rows with different quantities make a ladder.
Inga priser i listan ännu: No prices in the list yet
Change the search or show all prices.
Listan räknar ut sina priser av regeln o: The list works out its prices by the rule above. Only enter a price here for an article that should deviate.
Lägg in ett pris per artikel. Artiklar u: Enter a price per article. Articles without a price here get the base price. Several rows for the same article with different "from quantity" make a quantity discount, and with dates you can prepare a price increase.
Ta bort priset? Det har inte börjat gäll: Remove the price? It has not started to apply.
Avsluta priset? Det gäller till och med: End the price? It applies up to and including yesterday and stays in the history, so you can see what it cost.
Kunderna i gruppen får den här listans p: The customers in the group get this list's prices. A customer with an own price list gets that one instead.
Ingen, kunderna får grundpriset: None, the customers get the base price
Change the search or the filter.
En kundgrupp samlar kunder som ska ha sa: A customer group gathers customers who should have the same prices, for example resellers. You give the group a price list, put the customers in the group on the customer's tab Prices, and can aim a campaign at the group.
Arkivera kundgruppen? Den kan inte välja: Archive the customer group? It cannot be chosen for new customers, but you can restore it later.
Priser för :name: Prices for :name
Kundens egen prislista går före gruppens: The customer's own price list takes precedence over the group's. Without either, the base price applies, unless a campaign is cheaper.
Det finns inga prislistor eller kundgrup: There are no price lists or customer groups yet.
Så här prissätts en vara i :currency til: This is how an article is priced in :currency for the customer today, at quantity 1. Invoices and quotes use the same rules.
Det finns inga artiklar som matchar. Art: No articles match. Articles are added under Register.
Kort och unik, till exempel ATER eller S: Short and unique, for example RESELL or SUMMER.
Tre bokstäver, till exempel SEK eller EU: Three letters, for example SEK or EUR.
Välj inga grupper om kampanjen gäller al: Choose no groups if the campaign applies to all customers.
Det finns inga kundgrupper ännu. Kampanj: There are no customer groups yet. The campaign applies to all customers.
Låt listan följa ett annat pris: Let the list follow another price
Priserna räknas då ut av grundpriset ell: The prices are then worked out from the base price or another list with a markup or a reduction, so they follow along when the base price changes. Prices you enter in the list take precedence over the rule.
−12 ger 12 % lägre pris, 5 ger 5 % högre: −12 gives a 12 % lower price, 5 gives 5 % higher.
Används för kunder som inte har någon eg: Used for customers without an own list, in the list's currency. Only one list per currency can be the default; if you choose this one, the other is no longer the default.
Utan prislistor gäller artikelns pris fö: Without price lists the article's price applies to everyone. Make a price list when a group of customers should have their own prices, when the prices should apply in another currency, or for a campaign. Start with a list that follows the base price minus a percentage, so you do not have to enter any price by hand.
Arkivera prislistan? Den används inte lä: Archive the price list? It is no longer used for new prices, but documents that already have a price from it do not change. You can restore it later.
Samla kunder som ska ha samma priser, oc: Gather customers who should have the same prices, and aim campaigns at them.
Egna priser per kundgrupp, i andra valut: Own prices per customer group, in other currencies and for campaigns. Without a price list the article's price applies.
Priserna i listan, med antalstrappor och: The prices in the list, with quantity ladders and dates.
